headline: Noon moves the bright patch.
body: The sun has left the left-hand pane and sits on the blotter, warm enough to feel through the paper. The van is gone. A bicycle leans where it idled, front wheel turned in.

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: on the blotter, off the glass

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: bicycle against the shutter, no van
